newsitem.title: USA: Intercell to issue shrs to Energy holders.
newsitem.headline: Intercell to issue shrs to Energy holders.

text.p: Intercell Corp said Wednesday that it would issue all of the remaining 3.55 million shares of its stock distributable to Energy Corp shareholders, effective immediately.
Intercell issued a news release saying the previous plan of liquidating dissolution was structured in six installments over three years, totaling 5.4 million common shares.
Rather than wait the full three years, the company said it accelerated the distribution of these shares "as a gesture of goodwill."
On July 7, 1995, Intercell said it purchased all the assets and liabilities of Energy.
On July 8, 1996, Energy, which which conducts no operations and whose only assets consist of Intercell's common stock, entered into the previous plan of liquidating dissolution with Intercell.
